fp4: coalesced+fused GEMV, 3.19x (was 0.12 TOPS, now 0.38 TOPS). Root cause was a dynamically-indexed float dec[] local array spilling to local memory; fusing decode+dot + coalesced uint4 row staging fixes it. Bit-identical parity. Adds fp4_memprobe diagnostic (385 GB/s floor; decode now 1.9x floor, was 4.6x).

fp4: MoE-shaped int8-activation GEMV (warp/row, int MAC, warp reduce) + parity vs quantized-activation reference. Measured 3.24x (0.384 TOPS), tied with the fp32 coalesced path - decode (nibble+codebook), not the MAC, is the cost. Both ~1.9x over the 383 GB/s memory floor, non-overlapping.

fp4: packed 256-byte codebook table in the int8 MoE-shaped GEMV -> 4.01x (0.475 TOPS), parity green. One shared lookup per byte (two FP4 codes) instead of a divergent lookup per nibble. Measured target: engine Q4_K iq_mmvq(12)=1.018 TOPS/572 GB/s on the same shape; FP4 is 2.1x behind because its E2M1 codebook is nonlinear (needs a lookup) while Q4_K codes are linear. Adds --benchmoe.

fp4: fix the 190x leak - stream-parameterised launchers, caller-owned workspace, NO per-call hipMalloc/hipDeviceSynchronize (matches iq_mmvq). Q8 MoE-shaped path: 0.283ms -> 0.1265ms = 1.061 TOPS / 8.91x naive, now matching the engine's Q4_K iq_mmvq (1.018 TOPS). Parity green. The per-call alloc+sync (~1ms) was ~190x the matvec at the engine's real expert shape (~6us).

docs(map): record the miss-path GPU seam - gu_kernel/down_kernel index blob_base + slot*blob_bytes over a plain base pointer, so passing the PinnedArena base + routed expert id computes misses on the GPU over REBAR with NO new kernel and NO CPU pool.
